en: A round, multi-view color postcard. The front shows several photographic scenes from the same city arranged in a circular collage: in the central circle is a tall red‑and‑white striped TV/radio tower on a hill overlooking the landscape; the surrounding segments depict a large modern square with a monument, modern hotel or apartment blocks with zigzag balconies, a hillside park with a large statue, and historic multi‑storey buildings with domes. The back is printed like a standard postcard with address lines, stamp box and price, all in Hungarian, and includes the word "PÉCS".
